items.title: TEAMWORK: From the Individual Lens to the Collective Lens
items.excerpt: How do we help people truly connect and work well together? The question has never been easy. We have invented countless ways to strengthen teamwork, yet few of them work, and those that do rarely last. Between 2012 and 2015, Google looked for what makes a team succeed through its well-known Project Aristotle. It began by assuming the answer lay in bringing exceptional individuals together. It found that success depends not on who is on the team, but on how the team works together.
